'''H1-K1''' was a [[Purifier droid]] from [[Iokath]] refurbished for use by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
H1-K1 appears in the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as a Cartel companion available from the Vigilant Defender Pack, added with Patch 5.1.2.
